about.title: Gameplay designer with technical production sense
about.lead: I design gameplay features from intent and prototype through specs, playtests, implementation coordination, and production tuning.
about.leadHtml: I am a Gameplay Designer who can move features from design intent through prototype, specs, playtests, implementation coordination, and production tuning.
about.featureText: I define the intent, write the spec, support implementation, review playtest signals, and tune the feature until it is ready for production.
about.feelText: I focus on core loops, combat feel, encounter pacing, and feedback so player actions stay readable and satisfying.
about.dataText: KPI dashboards and playtest notes help validate tuning decisions, but the design goal stays grounded in player feel.

resume.title: Education and practical experience
resume.text: My path combines Software Engineering, Unity development, and gameplay-focused design. I use that technical base to write specs, coordinate implementation, run playtest iteration, and tune features with KPI support.

skills.gameplayDescription: Design mechanics, core loops, progression, and feedback that make player intent readable in play.
skills.gameplayProof: Prototype breakdowns, combat readability notes, and case-study decisions focused on player feel.
skills.ownershipDescription: Own gameplay features from design intent through specs, implementation coordination, playtest iteration, and production tuning.
skills.ownershipProof: Feature specs, handoff notes, tuning passes, and cross-functional coordination.
skills.combatDescription: Shape combat feel, enemy behavior, boss mechanics, and encounter structure around readable player action.
skills.combatProof: Boss mechanics, enemy behavior notes, and encounter readability work.
skills.docsDescription: Write design documentation that turns ideas into specs, content plans, and implementation tasks.
skills.docsProof: GDD-style specs, content plans, and developer-facing handoff notes.

journey.navNote: A personal inspiration map, not a ranking board.
journey.heroLead: A curated map of games that influenced how I think about worlds, stories, systems, player feeling, and the lessons that come from friction.
journey.intro: This page is not a tier list. It is a set of editorial shelves: games I lived in, stories that stayed with me, loops I kept returning to, systems I learned from, milestones that shaped my taste, and flawed experiences that still taught useful design lessons.

principles.title: World texture
principles.body: Small travel beats, local stakes, and environmental memory make a place feel authored.

principles.title: Readable goals
principles.body: Strong loops keep the next useful action clear without flattening discovery.

principles.title: System tension
principles.body: Good progression asks the player to trade comfort, risk, economy, and timing.

principles.title: Style as function
principles.body: UI, music, routine, and pacing work best when they reinforce the same fantasy.

principles.title: Player trust
principles.body: Friction is useful when it teaches; it becomes noise when feedback feels unfair.
